usedFor: Applivery holds builds and feedback, and Documint fills a document when “New Feedback Report” runs “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feedback Report” in Applivery, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: Each tester bug report is added to a Documint template, so reports come out in one format.

watchOut: “New Build Uploaded” and “New Build Processed” both fire for one build, so pick one to avoid two documents.
